purpose: Test whether the exploratory signed race-day bodyweight-change association survives adjustment for the previously observed odds-deterioration diagnostic association in exact T009R row-level data.

governance.retrospective_warning: If executed on 2025H2, this is retrospective diagnostic replication/decomposition because the signed-bodyweight hypothesis was formed after inspecting an adjacent-lineage 2025H2 screen. It is not untouched OOS or confirmatory evidence.

required_exact_inputs.model_lineage: T009R exact only; T011/T009-parent substitution prohibited
required_exact_inputs.market_probability: 10-minute pre-race win odds snapshot normalized within race, using the existing frozen timing convention
required_exact_inputs.historical_odds: previous-start odds under the existing T009R historical-feature definition
required_exact_inputs.bodyweight: current race-day bodyweight and previous-start bodyweight
required_exact_inputs.keys: race_key + horse identifier/number with uniqueness checks

fixed_variables.odds_deterioration: log(odds_10m / previous_start_odds); positive means current market odds deteriorated versus previous start

population.period: 2025H2 if exact historical artifacts are recovered; no 2026 rows
population.rows: actual starters with valid exact T009R probability, valid 10m odds, previous-start odds > 0, current bodyweight > 0, previous bodyweight > 0

primary_models.purpose: Check whether the adjacent-lineage signed association transfers directionally to exact T009R.
Determine whether signed bodyweight change retains an independent conditional association after odds-deterioration adjustment.

predeclared_interpretation.NO_TRANSFER: M0 beta_signed is not negative with two-sided p < 0.05. Stop: adjacent-lineage signal does not transfer to exact T009R on this retrospective diagnostic period.
predeclared_interpretation.TRANSFER_BUT_NOT_INDEPENDENT: M0 is negative/significant but M1 beta_signed is not negative/significant after odds-deterioration adjustment. Treat signed bodyweight as consistent with confounding/mediation by the previously observed odds-deterioration association; do not call it an independent mechanism.
predeclared_interpretation.INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_ONLY: M0 and M1 beta_signed are both negative/significant. This qualifies only as a retrospective independent-candidate signal requiring genuinely sealed/untouched confirmation; it does not authorize feature adoption or Gate promotion.
predeclared_interpretation.interaction: Report beta_interaction and CI as predeclared secondary context; do not let interaction significance override the primary M1 beta_signed classification.

effect_scale_reporting: Report raw beta per 1.0 proportion change and rescale to disagreement change per 1 percentage-point bodyweight change.
Report median, IQR, 1st/99th percentiles, min/max of signed bodyweight change.
Report unadjusted-to-adjusted beta attenuation continuously as 1 - abs(beta_M1)/abs(beta_M0) when beta_M0 != 0; no post-hoc attenuation cutoff will determine the verdict.

robustness_sensitivity.winsorization: Repeat M0 and M1 after winsorizing signed_bodyweight_change at the sample 1st and 99th percentiles; this sensitivity cannot upgrade a failed primary result.
robustness_sensitivity.extreme_influence: Report race-cluster influence diagnostics or leave-one-race-out maximum coefficient shift if computationally feasible; diagnostic only.

falsification: Failure of exact T009R row-level artifact integrity or timing provenance => INCONCLUSIVE, not a substitute-data result.
M0 passes but M1 fails => TRANSFER_BUT_NOT_INDEPENDENT.
No result from 2025H2 can be described as fresh OOS or confirmatory for this hypothesis.
